title: PilotTrace Navigation Replay Pack
description:
Deterministic, fully synthetic software replay of GNSS-denied maritime navigation (seed 42): nominal GNSS, total dropout, jamming-like noise, spoofing offsets, inertial drift and sensor dropouts with labelled degradation events. Navigation residuals are mapped explicitly into 16×32 OES-512 frames and scored through the unmodified pilottrace package with the latch S = 0.45·Peak + 0.35·RMS + 0.20·MeanAbs ≥ 0.50, fail-closed on NaN, infinity and bad shapes, with a hash-based provenance manifest and evidence report.

Measured on the synthetic scenarios: dropouts, jamming and missing sensors latch immediately with no alarms on the nominal run, while a slow self-consistent spoof is not detected while active.

Boundaries. Synthetic data only. No physical sensor or other hardware. No sensor benefit, calibration or fitness for operational use is established. Not a navigation, integrity or safety system.
